body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul; add LWM/Adaptive Storage when testing modded storage) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement" (its palette pin may log "Could not find node..." at startup - run it manually). Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## PASS 41 — COLUMN STORAGE INDEX (rebuild of cross-level hauling; user directive "build 2 - a database of storage zones/shelves/modded storage + priority; drive pawns; vanilla-close, no ceiling")
**WHY:** the reactive push/fetch/relay/cache tangle kept exposing one edge case after another because no component had a column-wide view of storage + priorities. 
**CORE INSIGHT:** vanilla already maintains per-map priority-sorted haul-destination lists, and `StoreUtility.TryFindBestBetterStorageFor(item, carrier:null, map, ...)` runs its full search WITHOUT reachability or a virtual-position swap and is Harmony-patched by LWM Deep Storage / Adaptive Storage Framework - so we get modded storage capacity/acceptance for free and can query any level cheaply.
- **Phase 1 (BUILT GREEN) — `Source/Logistics/ColumnStorage.cs`:** `TryFindBetter(pawn, item, out map, cell, dest, tier)` runs the carrier-less vanilla search on every level of the column and keeps the single best result; returns a CROSS-LEVEL target only for a strictly-higher tier on another level (equal tiers / the item's own level win on ties, so equal never crosses). `BestTierInColumn` + `FirstHopToward` helpers. No virtual swaps, no per-item cache, vanilla-parity perf (≤3 early-breaking searches). Decision is coarse (no reachability); execution validates per hop.
- **Phase 2 (BUILT GREEN) — route all decisions through it:** `CrossLevelHaul.TargetLevelFor`'s storage branch now calls `ColumnStorage.TryFindBetter` + `FirstHopToward` (replacing the up/down virtual-swap `Check` + the coarse `LevelAcceptsItem`); it satisfies strictly-better + best-of-up/down + multi-hop-upgrade in ONE call. `CrossLevelHaulJob.Build` turns a 2-gap target into an `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` relay hop; all storage givers (`WorkGiver_ABHaulToBetterLevelStorage/AcrossLevels/Bulk`) route far targets through Build (removed the old `TryStartFarHaul` fallback). `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive` uses `ColumnStorage` for its continue-decision (so a downward relay keeps going DOWN to Critical, not bouncing up). Fetch giver: fixed the `!anyHaulables && !wantDemand` early-out that skipped IN-STORAGE upgrade candidates (now also runs when the target has storage) so an idle pawn goes to an unoccupied level to start an upgrade. `TargetLevelFor` verdict cache kept but with the p40 `sourceMapId` invalidation.
- **Phase 3 (PENDING) — event-driven upgrade DRIVING:** replace the fetch's bounded in-storage scan with a storage-change-triggered re-check of outranked storages' contents (no per-tick all-item scan; the "no ceiling" requirement).
- **Phase 4 (PENDING) — work-migration reads ColumnStorage** for cheap cross-level haul-work detection (the work-priority perf win).

## Locked decisions (unchanged doctrines, now implemented via ColumnStorage)
Cap 3 levels. See-below = render overlay + input hooks. Designators OUT OF SCOPE (except internal re-stamp of Haul on a relay drop). Cross-level storage move only for a STRICTLY-higher tier than the item's best-local; equal never crosses; best-of-up/down; multi-hop = one-hop-then-relay (store here or set down + re-designate). Vanilla HAULABILITY PARITY: non-alwaysHaulable things (chunks) need Orders->Haul or in-storage. Allow Tool Haul Urgently (ignorePins) bypasses. COMBAT/FoW doctrines per pass 38/39. Soft-compat: foreign types never in a signature (CAI reflection-only). RE-ENTRANCY: coalesce nulls; don't TryTakeOrderedJob re-entrantly from a stair-transfer callback carrying an item.

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · p33 see-below · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · p40 chunk designation gate · p40 multi-hop relay UPWARD · p40 pull-side fetch (designated). (Downward relay + in-storage upgrade were the last failing cases - the reason for the pass-41 rebuild.)

## Compat
Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk; heavy-stack fallback) · **LWM Deep Storage + Adaptive Storage Framework (pass 41: honored automatically via vanilla's patched storage search)** · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE (p38) · CAI 5000/Krkr.rule56 (p39) · Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus (p40 coalesce) · Deep Storage-style containers via IHaulDestination · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
**PASS 41 (TOP) — test Phase 1+2 before Phases 3/4:**
- Downward upgrade+relay: Normal chunks in a SKY stockpile, build a Critical BASEMENT stockpile, pawns on the surface -> chunks flow sky->surface->basement into Critical and STAY (no stall/bounce; RMB on a mid-relay surface chunk shows a haul option). 1-hop (surface Normal -> basement Critical) and reverse (basement Normal -> sky Critical).
- Regression: designated basement chunks -> sky stockpile (upward relay); stop-at-first-accepting with a surface stockpile; equal-priority two levels -> no cross; chunk designation gate; PUAH no loop; Melee cross-level RMB no red error.
- (Modded storage: if LWM/Adaptive Storage added later, confirm items flow into their containers across levels.)

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 41, Phase 1+2 BUILT GREEN 0/0, awaiting in-game verify): rebuilt cross-level hauling on a `ColumnStorage` query engine (carrier-less vanilla per-level search - mod-safe, no virtual swaps, no cache) after the reactive system kept exposing edge cases (latest: downward sky-Normal->basement-Critical relay stalled on the surface). All haul decisions now route through it (best-tier, far->relay, upgrade detection); fetch early-out fixed for in-storage upgrades. Phase 3 (event-driven upgrade driving) + Phase 4 (work-migration perf) next. Testing ISOLATED + dev column; PUAH + Melee companions.
